steps.title: Pick something familiar

faq.q: What are good games for people with dementia?
faq.a: Ko ngan kangape ko ibe ko ngan a kakabo, ko ngan a pressure: pictures ko boboi ko ngan a matching, sorting, jigsaw ko ibe, ko ngan a finishing ko sayings ko ibe, colouring, picture bingo ma conversation cards. Ko ngan ko ibe ko mwi ko ngan ko ibe ko oni ko ngan e ngan ko ngan ko ibe. Ko timers, scores ma ko ngan ko ngan a test, ko ngan ko ibe ko ngan.

faq.q: Ko ngan kangape ko dementia ko free?
faq.a: Aiwo. Ko ngan ma printable ko Golden Moments ko free, ko ngan account, sign-up ma download. Ko ngan ko ibe ko web browser ko phone, tablet ma computer.

faq.q: Ko brain games ko ibe ko prevent dementia?
faq.a: Ko ngan ko oni ko ibe ko prevent dementia, ma Golden Moments ko ngan ko claim ko treat ma prevent ko ngan. Ko ngan ko ibe ko enjoyment ma ko time ko ngan. Ko brain health ko ngan ko explain ko research ko ngan ko show ma ko ngan ko show.

faq.q: Ko ngan ko ibe ko someone ko Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Aiwo. Alzheimer's ko most common cause ko dementia, ma ko ngan ko ibe ko ngan: pictures ko stay showing, choices ko kakabo, ma ko nothing ko remember ko ngan get wrong. Matching, sorting ma finishing ko sayings ko familiar ko ngan ko lean ko long-held knowledge, ko ngan ko learning ko ngan.

faq.q: Ko someone ko later-stage dementia ko ngan ko use ko activities?
faq.a: Ko ngan ko often, aiwo, ko someone ko beside. Start ko Find the same ko two pictures, Picture pairs ko four tiles, coloring page ma calm breathing pause. Keep ko short, follow ko lead ko ngan ma stop ko when ko ngan had enough.

faq.q: Ko information ko ngan ko private?
faq.a: Ko site ko ngan ko accounts ma ko advertising. Ko ngan ko use Google Analytics ko understand ko pages ko visited. Ko photos ko ngan ko choose ko Photo pairs ko shown ko browser ko ngan ma ko ngan uploaded.

faq.q: Ko who ko make Golden Moments?
faq.a: Golden Moments ko small team ko making calm, adult picture activities ko families ma caregivers, ko web ma ko free app. Ko ngan clinicians, ma nothing ko here ko medical advice.

about.title: A Shared Activity, Not a Memory Test
about.description: Why Golden Moments games have no timers, scores ma streaks, why pictures stay showing, ma what we will ma will not claim about dementia.
about.lede: Golden Moments makes calm, adult picture activities that a caregiver ma someone living ko dementia can enjoy side by side.
about.bodyHtml:
Me aita aea iduwen

Te bwiida me aea ninino e nita me iya: dorer, mema, te omar in te piksa erik, me nita in tekawa ma etea. Ete iat bwe anang engame, teik bwe e magit me aea iduwen meta.

Aebum app in brain-training e re iat mwin, score, streaks me levels. Bwiin engame ngaga etea dementia, e kona nita me exam me ete kona pass. Aita erian teina me aita touwi tarawong nein:

  • Eke me ko fail. Eke clock, score, move counter, mour, streaks, confetti me countdown, iat screen roo.
  • Aea me omar ngaga keta iat baga. Piksa roo e re keta kakar. Dorer e mena dorer me ete quiz eta me aea ngaga orin.
  • Gagago, plain me kateitei. Dorer gagago me piksa gagago, contrast obwien, me control roo e keta iat tebana ebika.
  • Dignity in engame gagago. Piksa in eb ebika me dorer plain me warm. Eke cartoons, sing-song praise me emoji rewards.
  • Marara bwe ko eao. “Done for now” e bita keta. Nuwaer bwe ko oiya iat nukan.
  • Private ean aita. Eke accounts me ads. Piksa roo ko aea e re keta iat device am.

Me aita ete claim

Games aita e nita bwe enjoyment me connection. They do not diagnose, test, measure, treat, slow or prevent dementia or Alzheimer’s disease, and no one should choose them for that reason. Ngaga aita erian research iat brain health pages aita, aita dorer plain ean te evidence me weak, me aita ete connect iat games aita.

Aita me iya

Golden Moments e nita team eke gagago me independent. Aita ete clinicians. Guide aita e erian ngaga guidance published bwiin organizations nita National Institute on Aging me Alzheimer’s Association, me guide roo e lists source roo. Read metu aita erian me check pages aita.

Dorer me aita me iya me kona help

Aita keta mwiya bwe aita runguw me iya me nuwaer me ete nuwaer, especially bwiin engame ngaga etea dementia, family caregivers me staff in activity. Email {email}.

editorial.title: Metu Aita Erian me Check Pages Aita
editorial.description: Metu Golden Moments aea research, erian, sources me update dementia activity me brain health pages, me metu aita ete publish.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Source aita

Aita touwi guide aita ean guidance bwiin organizations nita National Institute on Aging, CDC, Alzheimer’s Association, Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, Family Caregiver Alliance me NHS, me peer-reviewed research nita Cochrane reviews me clinical trials gagago. Guide roo e lists source roo me e relies on. Aita open source roo ean aita cite, me aita report me iduwen e dorer.

Metu aita erian

  • Practical ean: me iya ko aea nita, iat dorer plain.
  • Iduwen ean evidence: aita dorer “linked with”, “may” me “the evidence is mixed” ngaga iduwen.
  • Respectful: aita erian ean engame ngaga etea dementia nita engame gagago, me aita ete use quizzing me shaming dorer.
  • Eke invented content: eke made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews me testimonials.

Engame me review pages aita

Pages roo e erian me check bwiin team in Golden Moments, ma help bwiin AI tools bwiin research me drafting. Page roo e check ma source roo bwiin team. Pages aita e ete review bwiin doctor me clinician, me aita ete claim otherwise. E nita general information, ete medical advice.

Me aita ete publish

  • Claims bwe game, eiy, supplement, fast me routine e prevent, treat, slow me cure dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes me scores me suggest bwe engame etea, me ete etea, dementia.
  • Advice bwe start, stop me change medicine roo.
  • Advertising me sponsored content ngaga disguised nita guidance.

Updates me corrections

Page roo e aea date ngaga last updated. Ngaga ko aea mistake me out-of-date source, email {email} me aita check promptly.

faq.title: Questions me Answers
faq.seoTitle: Dementia Games and Activities: Questions and Answers
faq.description: Answers bwiin questions ean dementia games me activities: games me ko try, amwa orin in play, ideas bwiin later-stage, brain health me privacy.
faq.lede: Answers me plain me obwien bwiin questions me caregivers aea tsieda.

items.q: Me games me best bwiin engame ngaga etea dementia?
items.a: Games me best e familiar, simple me eke pressure, me game me nuwaer e me engame aea mwiya nita. Picture matching ma piksa roo keta, sorting, jigsaws me marara, finishing sayings me familiar, coloring me picture bingo e nuwaer bwiin engame roo. Eke timers, scores me meta me nita test.
Eeyo. Ekeke ni mweng ekakaiang ma ran ekakairũ ar fri, ko ekeke ka account, sign-up, download ma advertising.

items.q: Imwin ruaiu na score, level ma timer?
items.a: Speed ma score e tauaniden ekakaiang ngan ekakairũ ibwa ekakairũ ekakaiang, ka a ekakaiang ngan mena ma ekakairũ. Ima tauaniden ekakaiang ibwa ran ekakairũ ma ran ekakaiang iuena ma mwa ekakairũ, ka a eko ekakairũ ibwa. Nau ka ekeke ni fail, ma e mwan ekakairũ ibwa ma ekakairũ ka ekaraom.

items.q: Ma ekakairũ ka mweng ekakaiang ibwa?
items.a: Phone, tablet ma computer ka browser ka modern. Tablet ka mweng ngan stand ma table e mweng ekakairũ ngan ran rua ni ekakaiang ngan. Laptop ka mweng ngan TV e mweng ekakairũ ngan group.

items.q: Ma eko ka mweng ekakaiang ngan ran ekakairũ ma photo ran mwa?
items.a: Eeyo. Photo pairs e tauaniden 2 ngan 6 photo ka ekeke ni tauaniden ibwa matching game. Ran photo e mweng ngan browser ma ekeke ni upload ko save.

items.q: Ekakaiang e mweng ekakairũ ngan ruaiu?
items.a: Ekakairũ e ekakaiang 10 ngan 20 minute, ma ekakairũ ka 2 minute e success. Ngauen ekakairũ ka tired ko frustrated ma ekakairũ ibwa ka ekaraom ngan ekakairũ e mweng. Ekeke ekakairũ ka ekaraom.

items.q: Ma iuena ran ekeke ka mweng ekakaiang?
items.a: Ekakairũ ran ekeke e ekaraom, ma ekakairũ e ekaraom ngan ekakairũ ibwa ma ngan ekakairũ ibwa. Ekeke ka tired, pain, ekeke ka unsure ko ekeke ka interest. Ngauen ekakairũ ibwa ka guide ka ekakairũ ran ekeke ka no.

items.q: Ekakaiang ka mweng ekakairũ ran dementia ka ekaraom ibwa?
items.a: Ekakairũ ma senses: ekakairũ music ka ekakairũ, hand massage ngan lotion, ekakairũ photo ngan ran rua, ekakairũ blanket ka soft, ekakairũ ibwa ma ekakairũ ngan picture game ka simple ngan ran ka mweng ngan ekeke. Later-stage guide ka mwa ekakairũ ibwa ideas.

items.q: Ma ekakaiang ka mweng ekakairũ ngan group ngan care home?
items.a: Eeyo. Picture bingo e mweng printable card ma caller ka on-screen, ma Finish the saying ma Conversation card e mweng ekakairũ ngan ekeke ka read aloud. Care home groups guide e tauaniden group size, seating ma adapting ngan mixed abilities.

items.q: Ma game e mweng prevent ko slow dementia?
items.a: Game ka aikakairũ ibwa ka prevent dementia, ma game ni ekakairũ ibwa ka claim ka. Cognitive stimulation ngan ekakairũ social e ekakairũ ibwa benefit ngan research ngan ran ka mild ngan moderate dementia, ma ekakairũ ka ibwa game ka prevent disease. Ekakairũ ka game ngan enjoyment ma connection.

Ekeke ma certainty. Research e link 14 health ma lifestyle factor ngan dementia risk, ka hearing loss, high blood pressure, physical inactivity ma social isolation. Ekakairũ ka ekeke ibwa e mweng lower risk ngan ran ibwa, ma ran ibwa ka do everything right ekakairũ ibwa e still develop dementia. Ekeke ka fault ngan ekeke.

items.q: Intermittent fasting e ekaraom ngan brain health?
items.a: Human evidence e limited ma early, ma research ibwa e ngan animal. Fasting e mweng risk ngan ran ka old, ekakairũ ngan diabetes medicine ko unintended weight loss, ma e not recommended ngan ran ka mweng dementia. Talk ngan doctor ekeke ka change how you eat.

Ko account ma ko ad. Ekakairũ ngan Google Analytics ekakairũ visit ma ekakairũ page ka ekaraom, ma browser ekakairũ ekeke ka soft sound. Photo ka ekeke ni tauaniden ngan Photo pairs e never upload. Ekakairũ privacy notice ngan detail.
Ko. Golden Moments e ngan recreation ma general information. Ngan health question, talk ngan doctor, ma ngan emergency, call 110.

handout.restHtml:
Ran tips

  • Choose time ka ran ekakairũ e at their best.
  • Start ngan easiest setting. Four tile e plenty.
  • Talk about picture. Conversation e often best part.
  • Stop while it still feels pleasant. Ending early e good outcome.

Also on site

  • Free printable: large-print word search, coloring page, conversation card ma picture bingo.
  • Activity idea ngan every stage, ma guide ngan playing together ma caring ngan yourself.

For enjoyment ma time together. Not medical advice, test ko treatment. Golden Moments e published ngan Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

app.bodyHtml:
Tomwin mwiniyo

Tomwin ko ami me yiyet tiles ko 4 me pictures ko rekiñ eni nañ. Ami pictures kokwi ne ñin rimerimre, ke ami konom kin ayo ko kimi nañ. Mwiniyo ko ayo imwi ko timer, score ke penalty. Ayo 4, 6, 8 ke 12 tiles.

Ayo nan iyo

Ayo family photos ko device eni photo picker. App ko ayo kopi ko kiñin para activities ko kimi. Ayo bon scan library eni ke bon change original photos ko ami; ko ayo up to 24 photos ni ano collection.

Ayo lookiño tomo

Lookiño ano picture ano tokweo. Prompts ko kwoy ayo conversation ke bon asking eni ayo rememberiño names ke ayo correct answer. Lookiño yo rekiñ.

Offline ayo me ayo kimi

Starter pictures ke all eight picture packs ko kiñin ni app. Kopi photos ko import ayo work offline. Choose originals ko stored ni iCloud kokwi ayo kiñin internet connection.

Bon account, bon photo-sync server

Kopi photos ko family ayo stay ni app ni device. Ayo remove kopi ko bon deleting originals. Device backups ko kwoy include app data. Read app privacy policy, ke app help walks through each step.

faq.q: Which game should we start with?
faq.a: Picture pairs ko 4 tiles ko calm first choice. Ke choosing between pictures kokwi too much, ayo try Find the same ko 2 pictures. Para group, ayo try Picture bingo.

faq.q: Do the games work on an iPad or phone?
faq.a: Yes. Every game work ni browser ni phones, tablets ke computers, ke pictures grow ayo fill screen. Tablet ko ni stand ko often ko most comfortable para eni rua.

faq.q: Are these games good for someone with Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Yes. Ko made para people living with dementia, ke Alzheimer's, the most common cause. Pictures stay showing, ko bon ño choices kin, ke bon nañ timed ke scored, so games lean on recognizing familiar things rather than remembering new ones.

faq.q: Are these memory games for seniors?
faq.a: Ko matching ke picture games ko any older adult ko enjoy, be ko built ko bon test memory: ni Picture pairs pictures stay face up unless you choose otherwise. Guide eni ko memory games for seniors with dementia explains how ayo keep any memory game gentle.

faq.q: Are there games for groups in a care home?
faq.a: Yes. Picture bingo ko printable cards ke on-screen caller, ke Finish the saying ke Conversation cards work well read aloud ni group.

gamePage.appText: App Golden Moments me eab obo e tsimine matching pija me kamwiwi me kadudu e owoma me pija me pamli, me e magum eab tsimine Wi‑Fi. iPhone, iPad me Android.
